source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Αφφίωνος Επίσκοπος Νόβγκοροντ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(; - 1652)». The day's line calls him Επίσκοπος while the page's prose says he was elected Μητροπολίτης Νόβγκοροντ in 1635; the page's own word is what is recorded in the office. This is a Russian saint on the Greek calendar, and the Greek page is the only source read for him here. His own day is this one; saint.gr also names him among the twelve hierarchs the synaxis of 10 Φεβρουαρίου enumerates, «Άγιοι Πάντες Ιεράρχες εν Νόβγκοροντ της Ρωσίας», and again on 4 October and the third Sunday after Pentecost. This folder was made from that synaxis, under the spelling Afphonius; the 6 April page spells him Αφφίωνος, which is the same man and the same year of repose, 1652.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
